beliefs: With all controls at minimum and switch off, the dot is at (0,0) with size 1.0 [E1]
Turning the switch on with all dials at minimum moves the dot to y=10, leaving x and size unchanged [E2]
The switch likely adds a fixed offset to y (or sets y to 10) independent of dials; how it combines with dials is unknown?
notes: Added the switch effect observed in E2: switch on shifts y from 0 to 10 while x and size stay put. Dials' effects remain unknown.
